variants.title: A｜快速传输工作台
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one high-fidelity Windows desktop application UI design image.
Product: “传”, an existing lightweight Windows LAN file and folder transfer application. Design a practical native desktop interface in Simplified Chinese for the current feature set: automatic nearby-device discovery, one selected destination, manual IP connection, Ping and temporary IP notes, drag/drop plus file and folder selection, concurrent task progress/speed/cancellation, manual batch receive approval with all/partial/reject, whole-folder selection, receiving directory access, automatic receive setting, and built-in Web service with copy/open URL for phone browser clients.
All visible interface copy must use concise, accurate technical terminology in Simplified Chinese, with Segoe UI / Microsoft YaHei style typography. Carefully typeset legible characters. Use authentic short labels rather than decorative placeholder text.
Rendering: sharp straight-on full Windows application window, landscape 16:10 composition around 1600 × 1000 design pixels, high resolution. Only the application window fills the canvas, with a small Windows title bar and minimize, maximize, close controls. No surrounding computer, desktop wallpaper, browser chrome, presentation board, multiple screenshots, or explanatory arrows. Flat practical product UI with consistent 8px spacing rhythm, 36px buttons, restrained outlined icons, clear contrast, no excessive shadows or gradients.
Shared demonstration data across variants: local PC “BIGMOUNTAIN” / “192.168.1.12”. Online devices: “DESKTOP-02” / “192.168.1.20” selected, “手机浏览器” / “192.168.1.35”, “NOTEBOOK-03” / “192.168.1.28”. An outgoing folder “项目资料” to DESKTOP-02: “24 个文件 · 1.28 GB”, status “发送中”, progress “65%”, speed “112 MB/s”, action “取消”. One incoming pending batch from 手机浏览器: “2 个项目 · 86 MB”, containing folder “方案图纸” / “8 个文件 · 82.8 MB” and “会议纪要.pdf” / “3.2 MB”; global “自动接收” is OFF so manual approval is consistent. A completed received file “操作说明.pdf” from NOTEBOOK-03: “3.2 MB”, status “接收完成”, action “打开文件夹”. Receiving directory “C:\Users\17630\Downloads\传”. Web service URL “http://192.168.1.12:45871/”.
Constrain the UI to these actual LAN capabilities. Do not add cloud storage, accounts, encryption or padlock guarantees, synchronization, scheduled backups, resume transfer, global network analytics, messaging input, or a persistent all-time history. Task records are for this session. No QR code because it is not part of the current UI. No fictitious software version change, no watermark, no marketing slogan.
Primary request: redesign A, the clearest everyday quick-transfer workbench, light Windows-native style.
Palette: bright white #FFFFFF, pale neutral sidebar #F4F5F7, almost-black text #20242A, cool gray dividers, a restrained muted blue #3567D6 accent for selected items, progress and primary buttons. Comfortable white space and a simple visual hierarchy.
Structure:
1. Left sidebar about 260px: compact “传” arrow logo, subtitle “局域网文件传输”; heading “附近设备” with a refresh icon and online count “3”. Three real device rows with device-type outline icons, IPs and small green online dots. DESKTOP-02 is clearly selected. Beneath list, small peer tools “Ping” and “IP 备注”; at bottom “手动连接”, “接收目录”, plus compact local identity “BIGMOUNTAIN” and IP.
2. Main area: heading “文件传输”; upper-right compact “自动接收” OFF switch and a “设置” button. A short selected-destination strip reading “目标设备：DESKTOP-02” and its IP.
3. Broad but not excessively tall file drop panel, around 170px tall, centered upload-folder line icon, readable label “拖入文件或文件夹”, helper “发送至 DESKTOP-02”. Put “选择文件” as filled-blue button and “选择文件夹” as secondary button inside the panel footer.
4. Directly below, an inline warm-amber pending-receive notice card: “待确认的接收请求”, from “手机浏览器”, “2 个项目 · 86 MB”; right-hand aligned buttons “拒绝”, “部分接受”, “全部接受”. Keep this visibly separate from the sending panel but do not show a modal covering the application.
5. Lower main area is “本次传输”, a compact row of tabs “全部”, “发送”, “接收” with “清除已结束” aligned right. Two generous transfer rows: active 项目资料 with horizontal progress exactly 65%, metadata 24 files/1.28GB, speed and cancel on the right; completed 操作说明.pdf with green check status and “打开文件夹”. Show direction labels and peer names clearly.
6. Bottom status strip shows “接收目录：C:\Users\17630\Downloads\传”; a small “Web 服务” button on the right. Do not put the long technical path into an error-style warning.
Prioritize target clarity, fast file selection, lightweight familiar Windows use, readable primary actions, and a compact pending approval row. Final image is a single coherent app screenshot, not a comparison collage.

Primary request: redesign B, an information-dense office workbench for repeated large batches and selective receive approval. This must have a clearly different information architecture from a simple drop-zone dashboard.
Palette: warm off-white background #F5F4F1, pure white working surfaces, charcoal text, subdued teal #1D766B primary accent, amber only for pending approval. Small 6px radii, fine dividers, restrained professional utility design. Crisp typography, tidy data table, no decorative illustrations.
Structure:
1. Compact top header: “传” and “局域网文件传输”, local identity BIGMOUNTAIN and 192.168.1.12, “自动接收” OFF, “设置”. Ordinary Windows window controls.
2. Narrow left pane about 235px, titled “在线设备”. The same three device rows, selected DESKTOP-02 with IP. Beneath selected peer add “Ping” and “IP 备注”. Bottom actions “刷新设备”, “手动连接”, “接收目录”, and “Web 服务”.
3. Center workspace about 790px is “传输任务”. At top, a compact horizontal send control bar: target chip “发送到 DESKTOP-02”, small drop hint “拖入文件或文件夹”, buttons “选择文件”, “选择文件夹”. This send bar occupies about 110px, leaving the most area for a detailed task list.
4. Status-filter tabs just above the task table: “全部”, “待确认 1”, “进行中 1”, “已完成 1”. A right-aligned text action “清除已结束”.
5. A realistic table with readable columns “项目”, “方向”, “设备”, “大小”, “状态”, “操作”. Row 1: folder 项目资料, 24 files as secondary text, “发送”, DESKTOP-02, 1.28GB, a 65% progress bar plus 112MB/s, “取消”. Row 2: selected incoming batch “方案图纸等 2 项”, “接收”, 手机浏览器, 86MB, amber “待确认”, selected-row treatment. Row 3: 操作说明.pdf, “接收”, NOTEBOOK-03, 3.2MB, green “接收完成”, “打开文件夹”. Rows use two lines of text at most, good alignment and generous 70px row height.
6. Fixed right inspection panel about 345px, visually distinct from the central table, heading “接收审批”. Show sender 手机浏览器 and its IP, total “2 个项目 · 86 MB”, helper text “选择需要接收的项目”. Two clearly selectable checkbox rows: folder 方案图纸 / 8个文件 / 82.8MB, and 会议纪要.pdf / 3.2MB. Both checked. The folder is a single selection unit, no individually checked child files. Include concise helper “文件夹按整体接收”. Show selection summary “已选择 2 个项目 · 86 MB”. Actions “拒绝整批” (outline), “接受所选” (filled teal). Include “全部接受” as an unobtrusive text action. At panel bottom, show receiving directory and a “打开目录” button.
7. Bottom status strip: “本机：BIGMOUNTAIN · 192.168.1.12” and “Web 服务已就绪”.
Prioritize batch inspectability, nonmodal approval, compact repeat transfers, and strong pending/active/completed distinction. Show enough blank space below three task rows to imply normal data scale. This is a single finished app screenshot, no presentation annotations.

Primary request: redesign C, a dark device-centric file-transfer workspace suitable for PC-to-phone browser transfers and long sessions. Give it a genuinely distinct grouping by connected device, with a persistent Web service panel. This is a file-transfer session view; it is NOT a chat messenger.
Palette: deep neutral charcoal #17191E, left pane #121419, central surface #1E2229, subtle borders #343944, highly legible near-white #EEF1F5 typography, muted violet #9A8CF4 accent, green completion statuses, quiet amber approval. No glowing neon, no glass panels, no flashy illustration.
Structure:
1. Full Windows window with discreet title bar; app header includes the “传” symbol and text “局域网文件传输”, a subtle online indicator, “自动接收” OFF and a gear-labelled “设置”.
2. Left device rail about 260px: section “附近设备” with refresh icon; online device rows for DESKTOP-02, 手机浏览器, NOTEBOOK-03 with their same IPs and clear Windows/browser glyphs. DESKTOP-02 is selected with restrained violet edge treatment. Beneath list are “Ping”, “IP 备注”, “手动连接”; local PC identity and “接收目录” access at bottom.
3. Main central workspace roughly 850px, header “DESKTOP-02” with secondary IP 192.168.1.20 and “在线 · Windows”. A small section label “与此设备的传输”. Large horizontally aligned transfer cards grouped by the selected peer rather than one global table. The active outbound folder card uses a clear “发送” direction arrow, “项目资料”, “24 个文件 · 1.28 GB”, accurate 65% progress bar, “112 MB/s” and an outlined “取消” button. A small completed card in this same device session may be “测试文件.txt · 12 KB · 发送完成”, an ordinary same-session completed transfer, without fabricated security claims.
4. A compact global incoming-request card above or below these session cards, visibly from “手机浏览器”: “待确认接收 · 2 个项目 · 86 MB”, with “拒绝”, “部分接受”, “全部接受”. Do not imply this request came from the selected desktop peer.
5. Main workspace lower area is the file-send dock: a simple bordered drop region labelled “拖入文件或文件夹”, destination “发送到 DESKTOP-02”, practical buttons “选择文件” and “选择文件夹”. There is NO text chat composer, no paper-plane messaging button and no avatars.
6. Right utility pane about 335px, heading “Web 服务”, green status “已就绪”. Explanatory text “手机浏览器访问此地址”, the genuine URL “http://192.168.1.12:45871/” in a high-contrast compact address field, buttons “复制地址” and “打开网页”. Beneath divider, “浏览器设备” with 手机浏览器 and 192.168.1.35, followed by a concise lower section “最近接收” containing “操作说明.pdf”, “来自 NOTEBOOK-03”, “3.2 MB · 接收完成”, button “打开文件夹”. This is current-session state, not a persistent history. At bottom show abbreviated receiving path with no inaccessible-directory warning.
7. A small bottom strip has “接收目录：C:\Users\17630\Downloads\传” and “局域网已连接”.
Prioritize legibility on the dark surfaces, obvious separation of selected-peer transfers from global receive requests, and fast mobile/browser entry. Keep each card practical with careful alignment and compact controls. Do not add QR codes, cloud drives, message features or unreal network charts. Final image is only a single polished application screenshot.
